seoTitle: Add a Product to Your GoDaddy Website Store
metaDescription: Selling physical items, digital downloads, or services on GoDaddy? Learn how to add product details, set pricing, and manage inventory in your store.
intro: Whether you're selling physical items, digital downloads, or services, GoDaddy's eCommerce builder makes it straightforward to get a product listed and ready to sell. This guide covers entering product details, pricing, images, and shipping so your store is set up correctly.

steps.heading: Open your store's product section
steps.body: Navigate to the product management area of your GoDaddy Website Store to begin adding a new listing.

steps.heading: Enter the product title and description
steps.body: Add a clear product title and description that explains what you're selling to potential customers.

steps.heading: Set the price and inventory
steps.body: Enter the price for your product and define inventory levels if you're managing stock for physical items.

steps.heading: Upload product images
steps.body: Add images that clearly show the product, since visuals play a big role in customer purchase decisions.

steps.heading: Configure shipping and categorize the item
steps.body: Set shipping options where applicable and assign the product to the right category so it's easy for customers to find.

faq.question: Can I sell digital downloads through GoDaddy's store?
faq.answer: Yes, the eCommerce builder supports digital downloads in addition to physical products and services.

faq.question: Do I need to set shipping for a service-based listing?
faq.answer: No, shipping settings mainly apply to physical products, so service or digital listings can typically skip that step.

faq.question: How many product images can I add?
faq.answer: GoDaddy's store builder allows multiple images per listing so you can show a product from different angles or use cases.

faq.question: Can I edit a product after it's published?
faq.answer: Yes, you can go back into the product listing at any time to update pricing, inventory, images, or descriptions.
